scene_templates.name: 旅行摄影风格历史场景
scene_templates.description: 生成真实的旅行摄影风格历史场景，适合作为自拍背景
scene_templates.template: A realistic travel photo, as if taken by a traveler with a handheld camera, street-level perspective, [historical location] as it looked in [year]. Local people in traditional clothing of that era, daily life on the street, buildings and landmarks clearly visible, cinematic natural lighting, slightly weathered travel photography look, film grain. Good composition for a selfie background with open space in the foreground.
scene_templates.author: 用户提供

scene_templates.name: 沉浸式体验历史场景
scene_templates.description: 第一人称沉浸视角的历史场景，好像用户亲身站在其中
scene_templates.template: A first-person immersive view of [historical location] in [year], as if the viewer is standing in the scene. Foreground may include the viewer's hands or objects they hold (e.g., a torch, a scroll). Surroundings filled with authentic architecture, people moving naturally, ambient details like weather, sound atmosphere implied. The perspective should create a strong sense of being inside the historical moment.
scene_templates.author: 系统预设

scene_templates.name: 重大历史事件场景
scene_templates.description: 展现某个重大历史事件正在发生的场景
scene_templates.template: A vivid historical scene depicting [historical event] at [historical location] in [year]. The composition captures the crowd, leaders, soldiers, or citizens actively participating. Period-accurate clothing and banners, dramatic atmosphere, and strong visual storytelling emphasize the significance of the event.
scene_templates.author: 系统预设

scene_templates.name: 奇幻融合历史场景
scene_templates.description: 将奇幻或未来元素融入历史场景，创造另类的时空交错氛围
scene_templates.template: A fantastical reinterpretation of [historical location] in [year], blending authentic period details with imaginative elements such as steampunk machinery, futuristic neon lights, or mythical creatures like dragons or phoenixes. Dramatic lighting, surreal atmosphere, and visually striking contrasts create an alternate-history vibe.
scene_templates.author: 系统预设

scene_templates.name: 微缩模型历史场景
scene_templates.description: 以乐高、沙盘或微缩模型风格展现历史场景
scene_templates.template: A miniature diorama of [historical location] in [year], designed as a detailed model with small figurines, tiny buildings, and stylized terrain. The scene looks like a handcrafted museum display or a LEGO set, with clear visual storytelling and playful aesthetic.
scene_templates.author: 系统预设
